description: Retrieve users that have been modified since a specified start time using the Incremental User Export API. Use when you need to sync or track changes to Zendesk users over time, such as for data warehousing, backup, or external system synchronization. Provide a start_time (Unix timestamp) and the API returns users that have been created, updated, or deleted since that time. Call repeatedly with the end_time from each response to paginate through all changes. This action is read-only and idempotent. Note: Data isn't available for the most recent minute due to eventual consistency. Users may appear as modified or deleted; interpret based on your use case.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for incremental user export.

per_page.description: The number of records to return per page (max 100).
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many user records to return on each page. You can request up to 100 per page.
per_page.title: Per Page

start_time.description: The Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Use the end_time from a previous response for subsequent pagination.
start_time.human_parameter_description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) marking where to start fetching incremental user data. Must be at least one minute in the past. Use the end_time from a previous response to get the next batch of changes.
start_time.title: Start Time

inputSchema.title: GetIncrementalUsersRequest

name: get_incremental_users

count.description: Number of users in this response
count.title: Count

end_of_stream.description: Whether this is the end of the incremental export stream. When false, use next_page or end_time to continue fetching.
end_of_stream.title: End Of Stream

end_time.description: Unix timestamp marking the end of this export window. Use this as the start_time for the next request to continue fetching changes.
end_time.title: End Time

next_page.description: URL for the next page of results. Use this to continue pagination if there are more records.
next_page.title: Next Page

users.description: List of user records that were modified since start_time
users.title: Users
